messages:
maya: quick heads-up — I noticed a mismatch between the function/tool-calling examples and the structured-output guidance. the SDK examples still show the old `tool_call` envelope, while the JSON schema doc expects a `toolInvocation` object. this is causing confusion in the migration guide. linking the PR i started: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1342

jordan: ah yeah i've seen that in a couple customer tickets. can you paste the minimal snippet that's wrong so i can patch it in the python + js samples?

maya: sure — current (incorrect) example in python: 
```python
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="redwood-large",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "call-weather"}],
    tool_call={"name":"get_weather","args":"{\"city\":\"SF\"}"}
)
```
expected shape in schema doc is more explicit: 
```json
{"toolInvocation":{"tool":"get_weather","params":{"city":"SF"},"annotation":"user-intent"}}
```
we should standardize to the JSON-first shape and show how SDKs map into it.

ravi: i can update the python + node snippets. @sasha can you own the migration guide examples and the parse heuristics section?

sasha: yup i'll take migration guide. question: do we want to keep a brief "compat shim" example showing how older SDKs map `tool_call` -> `toolInvocation`? could be helpful for customers on older pinned versions.

jordan: yes please include a tiny shim example, one line mapping + a note about nullable fields and arrays. keep it short.

maya: for the shim we recommended earlier: 
```js
// legacy -> canonical shim
if (resp.tool_call) {
  resp.toolInvocation = {
    tool: resp.tool_call.name,
    params: JSON.parse(resp.tool_call.args || "{}")
  }
}
```
add a caveat about try/catch around JSON.parse.

doc-bot: link-checker: running on changed files... found 2 broken links: docs/en/sdk/python.md#tool-calls -> 404, and tutorials/parse-cookbook.md#edgecases -> 404.

ravi: thanks bot. i'll fix the python anchor and add a redirect. also updating the sdk snippet PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1347 (wip).

sasha: i'm adding a short section in migration guide: "structuring tool output" with a small eval example and recommended JSON schema. will reference the canonical schema at /docs/schema/toolinvocation.json.

maya: reminder: update the examples in the quickstart template too (templates/toolcall-example) — prod customers hit that first.

jordan: assigned in PR review: i'll take python snippets + link fixes, ravi takes node + SDK samples, sasha takes migration guide text. maya will finalize the canonical schema doc. who can add a small unit test in docs-ci to flag schema/example mismatches?

ravi: i can add a CI check that runs `scripts/validate_examples.py` and diffs examples against the canonical schema. quick command: `python tools/validate_examples.py --schema docs/schema/toolinvocation.json --examples docs/en/examples/*.md`

sasha: sounds good. i'll add one example to the migration guide that deliberately demonstrates an ambiguous parse and how to avoid it (use explicit `annotation` field).

maya: updated PR with schema changes and a short note on guardrails (PR#1342 -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1342). please take a look for wording: "Prefer explicit toolInvocation object with stable keys: tool, params, annotation."

jordan: review done for python snippets — left two tiny nits (one is a backtick). pushed fix in PR#1347.

doc-bot: deploy-preview: staging docs site updated for PR#1347 and PR#1342 — preview URLs: https://deploy-preview-1347--docs.redwood.ai and https://deploy-preview-1342--docs.redwood.ai

ravi: i've added the shim example and a one-liner mapping in node. pushed in PR#1347.

sasha: migration guide updated and link-checked. added a short subsection "When to prefer schema strictness vs heuristics" with examples. pushed in PR#1350.

maya: great — can we aim to merge these by EOD tomorrow? i'll coordinate with eng on the CI check so it doesn't block unrelated doc changes.

jordan: ack. i'll re-run the link-check locally and then merge once CI is green. thx everyone! :rocket:

ravi: merged PR#1347 this morning, will watch staging for any regressions.

sasha: merged PR#1350, left a follow-up issue for adding an interactive example playground (issue #412).

maya: marking this thread as resolved — opening a small post-merge follow-up to add a unit test for the shim. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
